The Aral Sea used to be one of the largest lakes in the world – until it lost 90% of its surface area. But there are signs of hope.

recentItems.title: No, this wasn't a "perfectly normal summer"
recentItems.description:
AfD leader Tino Chrupalla called Germany's extreme summer "perfectly normal" and dismissed concerns as scaremongering. But temperature records — and climate science — tell a different story. 


#ClimateChange #ExtremeHeat #DWEnvironment

recentItems.title: How greed is turning Spain into a desert
recentItems.description:
Spain is Europe's greenhouse. Vast, plastic-covered fields dominate its southern coast to produce up to 25 percent of Europe's fruit and veg. But this has a price. Spain is experiencing its worst water crisis in history, with thousands of illegal wells drilled to irrigate farms aggravating the problem — all for cheap, year-round produce for the richer countries up north. 

#PlanetA #Spain drought #illegal wells #water crisis #groundwater depletion
